name: Yahweh (early Israelite)

identifications.note: Historical assimilation/identification in early Israelite religion; this does not by itself establish Yahweh's ultimate geographic origin or prove Yahweh and El were always identical.

domain_history.domain: divine-war and storm-theophany imagery including motifs that scholarship compares with and traces through Baalistic/Canaanite imagery

notes: This node is intentionally historical and pre-exilic. It is not a timeless theological definition of the God of later Judaism or Christianity.
